page: Microsoft Azure ND128isr_NDR_GB200_v6 is an isolated, RDMA-capable virtual machine belonging to the NDISRGB200V6NDR family. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the arm64 CPU architecture, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance provides a dedicated CPU allocation model, ensuring consistent compute resources without virtualization-induced resource contention.

The server is equipped with 864.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 6.75 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 16408 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity. It is also designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-speed external storage volumes.

This virtual machine integrates a single GPU accelerator alongside its high-density compute resources. Network connectivity is enhanced by RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) capabilities, which support low-latency, high-throughput inter-node communication. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

Given the combination of dedicated arm64 processors, a hardware GPU accelerator, massive local NVMe SSD storage, and RDMA networking, this server represents a high-density resource profile. It is designed for distributed machine learning workloads, large-scale data processing, and GPU-accelerated database systems that require high-speed local scratch space and low-latency node clustering.
